as_told.title: Holloman Air Force Base landing and meeting with generals
as_told.place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

related.note: Both are James Fox telling of a UFO landing at Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico. This telling ties the landing to a claimed meeting with Eisenhower, while the story places it in 1964 and rests it on footage Allan Sandler saw. Those are competing accounts of when the landing happened and who was there, so either could be right.

plain: The story is that a craft once landed at Holloman Air Force Base in New Mexico, and that some of the generals on the base may have met the beings who came out of it. No date is given. The UFO investigator James Fox says he is now "kind of convinced" the landing really happened. He does not name a source, though he brings up President Eisenhower when he talks about it. Michels tells a fuller version and gives a source. He traces it to a documentary film called UFOs: Past, Present and Future and to two men tied to it, Rod Serling and Bob Emenegger. In his version, generals had "a possible interaction" with "these tall beings." So one teller is an investigator who has come to believe it, and the other is the host passing on what that film presented. If true, it would mean the military had met beings face to face on one of its own bases.
